# The failures of the whole suite under COSMIC_GRAMMAR=new that the rehearsal job (ci.yml, `platform rehearsal`) expects, one
# `<failure> -- <reason>` a line: a test (`<module> <test>`), a module the new checker refused (`<file> <code>`, the code of its
# first error: it stays expected for that reason alone) or a C function no test entered (`<file>:<function>`). The job fails for a
# failure that is not here and for an entry whose failure did not happen, so the list only shrinks, and is empty at the switch
# (doc/plans/strict-teal.md, "the switch").
build.harness_epoch_test test_the_harness_is_acknowledged -- the acknowledged digests of cosmic.child, cosmic.fs and cosmic.sqlite are over the fork's Lua; the new generator writes the layout the `[generated]` comparison sets aside, so the digests move; drop it once the digests are taken over the new generator's Lua at the switch
cosmic/removed_example.tl method_in_record -- the fixture spells `function Friendly:greet` outside its class on purpose, a form the new grammar refuses (method_in_record); it stays refused until the fixture moves into its class with the switch
doc/guides/project.md function_path -- the guide's example declares `function Kv.Lru.get`, a path of more than one dot (function_path) that the new grammar refuses; it is rewritten with the switch
build.importer_store_test test_argument_hint_does_not_sniff_the_whole_source_line -- the pointer `cosmic docs generics_functions_returns` names an example of cosmic/removed_example.tl, which the new grammar refuses (below), so the docs hold no example to point to; goes with that file
build.importer_store_test test_language_errors_name_relevant_checked_docs -- the pointers `cosmic docs generics_functions_returns` and `records_interfaces_methods` name examples of cosmic/removed_example.tl, which the new grammar refuses (below), so the docs hold none to point to; goes with that file
